name: Storyboard Maker
description: One still per shot (clips of the first video track that has clips) or per marker of the active sequence, then a contact sheet with titles and timecodes (PNG and PDF). Stills come from the Program monitor and are written next to the saved project, in <project>-storyboard/. It reads the saved .fcproj, so save first. The sheet needs Python 3 with Pillow (pip3 install pillow); the stills do not. Programs run with your user's permissions.
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Exporter une image par plan
entries.description: A still half a second into each clip of the first video track (or its middle for a shorter clip).

entries.label: Exporter une image par marqueur
entries.description: A still at each sequence marker, titled with the marker's name and comment.

entries.label: Assembler la planche (PNG + PDF)
entries.description: Contact sheet of the stills exported last, 3 columns (--var columns=4), with titles and timecodes. Writes <project>-storyboard.png and .pdf next to the project.
